scope: Targeted primary-prior audit, not exhaustive novelty clearance

papers.title: Revisiting Batch Normalization For Practical Domain Adaptation
papers.reviewed: Section3.2,page4 Algorithm1; gamma and beta retained while target activation mean/variance recalibrate BN. Rendered page4.
papers.overlap: Ordinary BN recalibration is prior art and a required control.

papers.title: CateNorm: Categorical Normalization for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
papers.reviewed: Section3,pages3-5,Equations1-4; learned spatially varying affine maps conditioned on predicted category masks. Rendered page3 and page4.
papers.overlap: Foreground-informed normalization and class masks are established; category control here is NOT a reproduction.

papers.title: DARC: Distribution-Aware Re-Coloring Model for Generalizable Nucleus Segmentation
papers.reviewed: Section2.3 pages4-5; foreground/background ratio alters IN statistics, predicts ratio for normalization. Rendered page3 and page4.
papers.overlap: Foreground/background ratio sensitivity is established, not an original motivation. No claim this SOD pilot reproduces DARC.

candidate_difference: Pool fractional tiny boxes with one unit of statistical mass per GT instance, rather than per spatial pixel or class; apply one fixed training-only pooled moment update to a single P3 class Conv-BN layer. This modest statistical difference is unproven and not sufficient novelty by itself.
prohibited_claim: Do not present foreground BN, AdaBN, a 0.03 momentum update or folding as innovation. A positive screen requires new-data replication, actual training comparison and a closer object-balanced normalization literature audit.
